summary: Skratch reviews nine new Legendary heroes revealed in the Chinese version for Season 9 ('Dark Tide is Coming'). The incoming roster promises significant meta shifts, particularly for Corrosion and Aura damage archetypes. Corrosion receives a dedicated defense-shredding enabler in Levier alongside a new exclusive artifact for Szechidith, while Horace Halfast provides Aura teams with an activator that triggers assist attacks and energy regeneration. Additional non-exclusive elemental supports for Fire, Frost, Poison, and Lightning are also covered.

heroes.name: Thea
heroes.note: Increases ally damage output, reduces damage taken, provides shields and healing, and inflicts debuffs on enemies.

heroes.name: Celestine
heroes.note: Heals allies, provides shields, cleanses debuffs, grants random buffs upon resisting status effects, and inflicts Karma to reduce enemy damage.

heroes.name: Sennis
heroes.note: Reduces enemy defense, buffs same-element ally attack, and pulls the highest-attack enemy into a Corruption Dimension to isolate them from combat.

heroes.name: Levier
heroes.note: Applies Bite to lower defense and directly increases enemy Corrosion values once stacks are capped, massively buffing overall Corrosion damage.

heroes.name: Holfast
heroes.note: Channels Aura energy to allies, grants damage buffs, triggers assist attacks, and restores Aura energy following his power skill.

heroes.name: Fei Lunzur
heroes.note: Heals allies, cleanses debuffs, and decreases enemy attack power and ultimate charge speed.

heroes.name: Amaryllid
heroes.note: Inflicts random debuffs on hit, gains self-shields and hit chance, and silences enemies within an area.

heroes.name: Lamb
heroes.note: Applies White Rat effect to shield and heal allies, and Black Rat effect to reflect enemy debuffs and control effects back at attackers.

heroes.name: Torin
heroes.note: Stuns enemies, shields allies through static charge stacks, knocks back targets, and reduces enemy attack and effect resistance.

teams.note: Corrosion receives a massive single-target buff via Levier accelerating stack application and Szechidith getting an exclusive artifact.
Holfast provides Aura teams with necessary activation, energy refund, and extra attacks to push team damage higher.

meta_changes: Corrosion meta shifts back toward top-tier single-target boss damage with Levier and Szechidith's exclusive artifact.
Aura archetype receives a dedicated activator hero in Holfast to unleash extra attacks and energy recovery.
Introduction of dimensional Banishment mechanics with Shadow hero Sennis to isolate boss/high-attack targets.
tips: Prioritize saving resources for enablers like Holfast if you already invested heavily into an Aura team.
Prepare gear for Corrosion heroes as the archetype is expected to dominate long single-target boss encounters.
title: GET READY!! Big Meta Changes Coming With The New Heroes... Dragonheir: Silent Gods x Dragonstride
